key.description: The cell key in each row, and what Marks report in columns.

unit.description: Shown after each number in the column.

numeric.description: Right-align it. Defaults to true when every value is a number.

id.description: What Marks report in rows. Defaults to r1, r2, …

cells.description: Values by column key: strings or numbers.

status.description: Adds a Status column: queued, running, done, approved, killed or failed are styled; any other word shows plain.

highlight.description: Row IDs to shade, such as the ones you just changed.
